description: This file defines an interface for credit bureau configuration write operations in the Fineract project, including methods to add and update configurations.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfigurationWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for credit bureau configuration management, including adding and updating configurations.

methods.name: addCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a new credit bureau configuration using the provided ID and command data.

methods.name: updateCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Updates an existing credit bureau configuration identified by configurationId with new data provided in the command.
